title: Residential Electricity Supply Off-Peak Line: Disputed Amount
content:
**Correct billing of an off-peak line.** On a Residential Electricity Supply time-of-use agreement, an off-peak energy line is correctly billed at its kWh times the contract rate times the plan's off-peak rate multiplier, and any amount billed above that is over-billed.

**Disputed amount.** The disputed amount is the billed amount of the agreement's largest off-peak energy line less that line's correctly billed amount. Because such a line was billed at the full contract rate, its correctly billed amount is its billed amount multiplied by the plan's off-peak rate multiplier (as the plan pricing schedule states it for the plan in force), rounded half up to the cent.

**Assembly and rounding.** A multiplier acts on the over-billed amount; flat amounts are added to that product; the total is rounded half up to the cent only once, at the end, and recorded as a positive disputed amount.

## Worked figures (hypothetical lines)

| Largest off-peak line billed | Off-peak rate multiplier | Correctly billed amount | Disputed amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| 186.40 USD | 0.00 | 186.40 multiplied by 0.00 is 0.00 USD | 186.40 USD |
| 186.40 USD | 0.50, an illustrative figure only | 93.20 USD | 93.20 USD |
| 175.35 USD | 0.25, an illustrative figure only | 43.8375, rounded to 43.84 USD | 131.51 USD |

**Which line.** Of the agreement's off-peak energy lines, the one with the largest billed amount is used, whatever its billing cycle.
